description: This file defines a React component named AuditPanel that displays audit findings related to an invoice, including general findings and purchase line item details. It utilizes Material UI components and custom hooks to fetch and render data, along with helper functions for formatting.

methods.name: formatAmount
methods.description: Formats a number to a fixed 2-decimal string or '-' if not provided.

methods.name: formatPercent
methods.description: Formats a fraction (e.g., 0.0825) into a percentage string (e.g., 8.25%).

methods.name: SeverityChip
methods.description: Renders a severity chip with color coding based on severity level.

methods.name: TaxStatusChip
methods.description: Renders a chip indicating the tax validation status.
